title.zh: 美股开盘，科技股抛售遭持续，英特尔暴跌25.7%
title.en: 美股开盘，科技股抛售遭持续，英特尔暴跌25.7%

current_state.zh: 英特尔10月30日收跌28.58%至65.76美元，创1970年代以来最差单日表现；美国政府持股价值单日缩水约120亿美元，英伟达持股价值缩水约60亿美元；第四季度营收和EPS指引显著低于预期，CFO预计PC市场放缓至少持续至2027年上半年；以色列晶圆厂爆炸预计造成约6亿美元营收损失；D.A. Davidson下调评级至中性。
current_state.en: Intel closed down 28.58% at $65.76 on October 30, its worst single-day performance since the 1970s; the US government's stake lost about $12 billion in value in one day and Nvidia's stake lost about $6 billion; Q4 revenue and EPS guidance came in well below consensus, the CFO expects PC-market weakness through at least H1 2027, and an explosion at its Israeli fab is expected to cost about $600 million in revenue; D.A. Davidson downgraded Intel to Neutral.

updates.title_zh: 美股开盘，科技股抛售遭持续，英特尔暴跌25.7%
updates.title_en: 美股开盘，科技股抛售遭持续，英特尔暴跌25.7%
updates.what_changed_zh: 美国股市大幅低开，纳斯达克指数下跌 2.2%，科技股抛售加深，英特尔因 PC 需求疲软和现金流担忧暴跌 25.7%，亚马逊因第四季度指引疲软下跌 5.3%，而埃克森美孚等能源股则上涨。
updates.what_changed_en: US equities opened sharply lower with the Nasdaq down 2.2% as the tech selloff deepened, led by Intel's 25.7% plunge on weak PC demand and cash-flow concerns and Amazon's 5.3% drop after soft Q4 guidance, while energy names like Exxon gained.

updates.detailed_summary_en: US equities opened sharply lower with the Nasdaq down 2.2% as the tech selloff deepened, led by Intel's 25.7% plunge on weak PC demand and cash-flow concerns and Amazon's 5.3% drop after soft Q4 guidance, while energy names like Exxon gained.

updates.title_zh: 美股遭遇「黑色星期五」：英特尔暴跌30%，英伟达市值失守5万亿美元
updates.title_en: 美股遭遇「黑色星期五」：英特尔暴跌30%，英伟达市值失守5万亿美元
updates.what_changed_zh: 盘中抛售扩大至半导体板块：英特尔跌幅扩大至30%，费城半导体指数跌5.7%，AMD跌约10%，Arm跌9.5%，英伟达跌3.3%且市值跌破5万亿美元；英特尔第四季度营收和EPS指引低于预期，并预计PC市场低迷至少持续至2027年上半年。
updates.what_changed_en: The intraday selloff widened across semiconductors: Intel fell 30%, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index dropped 5.7%, AMD fell about 10%, Arm fell 9.5%, and Nvidia fell 3.3% with its market cap below $5 trillion; Intel's Q4 revenue and EPS guidance missed expectations and management expects PC weakness to persist at least through H1 2027.
updates.current_state_zh: 10月30日美股科技股抛售加深并扩散至半导体板块，英特尔因疲弱指引暴跌30%，英伟达市值跌破5万亿美元，纳指100一度跌约3%，标普500跌约1.25%；能源和医疗保健板块逆势上涨，市场轮动加剧。
updates.current_state_en: The October 30 US tech selloff deepened and spread across semiconductors, with Intel plunging 30% on weak guidance, Nvidia's market cap falling below $5 trillion, Nasdaq 100 down as much as about 3%, and S&P 500 down about 1.25%; energy and healthcare gained as rotation intensified.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: US semiconductor stocks sold off sharply on October 30, with Intel plunging 30% after weak fourth-quarter guidance and Nvidia falling below a $5 trillion market cap as Amazon results and AI spending concerns deepened the tech selloff.
updates.detailed_summary_en: US semiconductor stocks sold off sharply on October 30, with Intel plunging 30% after weak fourth-quarter guidance and Nvidia falling below a $5 trillion market cap as Amazon results and AI spending concerns deepened the tech selloff.

updates.title_zh: 美股周五三大股指低收，费半跌超7%，英特尔暴跌28.58%
updates.title_en: 美股周五三大股指低收，费半跌超7%，英特尔暴跌28.58%
updates.what_changed_zh: 10月30日美股收盘确认科技股与半导体板块大幅收低：纳指跌2.86%，标普500跌1.82%，费城半导体指数跌7.2%；英特尔收跌28.58%，创至少四十年来最差单日表现，闪迪、高通、AMD、美光、英伟达等芯片股同步下跌。
updates.what_changed_en: The October 30 US close confirmed a sharp tech and semiconductor selloff: Nasdaq fell 2.86%, S&P 500 fell 1.82%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index dropped 7.2%; Intel closed down 28.58%, its worst single-day performance in at least four decades, while SanDisk, Qualcomm, AMD, Micron, and Nvidia also fell.
updates.current_state_zh: 10月30日美股收盘，科技股与半导体板块抛售确认加深：纳指跌2.86%，标普500跌1.82%，费城半导体指数跌7.2%；英特尔收跌28.58%创至少四十年来最差单日表现，英伟达、AMD、高通、美光等芯片股同步走低。
updates.current_state_en: At the October 30 US close, the tech and semiconductor selloff was confirmed and deepened: Nasdaq fell 2.86%, S&P 500 fell 1.82%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index dropped 7.2%; Intel closed down 28.58% in its worst single-day performance in at least four decades, with Nvidia, AMD, Qualcomm, and Micron also lower.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: US equities closed sharply lower on Friday, with the Nasdaq falling 2.86% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index dropping 7.2%, while Intel collapsed 28.58% in its worst single-day performance in at least four decades, dragging chip peers SanDisk, Qualcomm, AMD and Nvidia lower.
updates.detailed_summary_en: US equities closed sharply lower on Friday, with the Nasdaq falling 2.86% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index dropping 7.2%, while Intel collapsed 28.58% in its worst single-day performance in at least four decades, dragging chip peers SanDisk, Qualcomm, AMD and Nvidia lower.

updates.title_zh: 英特尔暴跌28.58%，美国政府持股价值单日蒸发约120亿美元
updates.title_en: 英特尔暴跌28.58%，美国政府持股价值单日蒸发约120亿美元
updates.what_changed_zh: 10月31日报道补充英特尔暴跌后的细节：英特尔收报65.76美元、跌28.58%；美国政府所持约10%股份价值单日缩水约120亿美元，英伟达所持股份价值缩水约60亿美元；第四季度营收指引150亿至160亿美元，低于LSEG预期的171亿美元，调整后EPS指引0.25美元，低于预期的0.43美元；CFO称PC市场放缓至少持续至2027年上半年，内存等零部件成本上涨；以色列晶圆厂爆炸事故预计两个季度造成约6亿美元营收损失；D.A. Davidson将英特尔评级从买入下调至中性。
updates.what_changed_en: The October 31 report adds post-selloff details: Intel closed at $65.76, down 28.58%; the US government's roughly 10% stake lost about $12 billion in value in one day, while Nvidia's Intel stake lost about $6 billion; Q4 revenue guidance was $15–16 billion versus LSEG consensus of $17.1 billion, and adjusted EPS guidance was $0.25 versus $0.43 expected; the CFO said PC-market weakness will persist at least through H1 2027 and memory/component costs are rising; an explosion at Intel's Israeli fab is expected to cause about $600 million in revenue loss over two quarters; D.A. Davidson downgraded Intel from Buy to Neutral.
updates.current_state_zh: 英特尔10月30日收跌28.58%至65.76美元，创1970年代以来最差单日表现；美国政府持股价值单日缩水约120亿美元，英伟达持股价值缩水约60亿美元；第四季度营收和EPS指引显著低于预期，CFO预计PC市场放缓至少持续至2027年上半年；以色列晶圆厂爆炸预计造成约6亿美元营收损失；D.A. Davidson下调评级至中性。
updates.current_state_en: Intel closed down 28.58% at $65.76 on October 30, its worst single-day performance since the 1970s; the US government's stake lost about $12 billion in value in one day and Nvidia's stake lost about $6 billion; Q4 revenue and EPS guidance came in well below consensus, the CFO expects PC-market weakness through at least H1 2027, and an explosion at its Israeli fab is expected to cost about $600 million in revenue; D.A. Davidson downgraded Intel to Neutral.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Intel fell 28.58% to $65.76 — its worst single day since the 1970s — after fourth-quarter guidance came in well below consensus, wiping roughly $12B from the US government's stake and $6B from Nvidia's, with the CFO flagging a PC slowdown through at least H1 2027, rising memory costs, and ~$600M in revenue loss from a fatal explosion at its Israeli fab.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Intel fell 28.58% to $65.76 — its worst single day since the 1970s — after fourth-quarter guidance came in well below consensus, wiping roughly $12B from the US government's stake and $6B from Nvidia's, with the CFO flagging a PC slowdown through at least H1 2027, rising memory costs, and ~$600M in revenue loss from a fatal explosion at its Israeli fab.
